children: Copper made Q2-2026 consolidated financials of Penney Intermediate Holdings LLC available, showing $54M net income for the quarter.
Released Q2-2026 consolidated statements and Master Lease store performance for periods ended Aug 1, 2026 and Aug 2, 2025; exhibits posted to investor site.
Penney Intermediate reported net income of $54M for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026 vs $110M prior year.
Trailing 12-month portfolio: 117 properties, 15.47M sq ft, tenant sales $72/sq ft and EBITDAR/rent of 1.1.
Penney Intermediate Q2: total revenues $1,364M, operating income $57M; six-month consolidated adjusted EBITDA $68M.
Liquidity at period end: $800M available; cash and cash equivalents for Penney Intermediate $110M as of Aug 1, 2026.
